title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What day is it today Greg
It’s Weather Day
FUCK I swear I was sitting on that.
But fair is fair. Send tweet and savor it. I’ll like from my burner
I’m running out of days
I have back up plans for rain so I’ll survive. Lake day? Beach day maybe? Forgot to bring our canoes? I’ve got my good mitt and my floppy floppies?
Lot of potential if I can’t use weather day
Ooooh those are good ... Lake day is great
“Only thing missing from Lake Day is a giant inflatable.”
I was trying to think of a climate change angle
Delivery of your Weather Day tweet was excellent
Needed the Gardy watching weather channel
[Attachment: Image]
Cabana Day, something about Al smoking cigars and watching the future
Lol that’s also good
I just sit up here and look for jokes
The garbage cans in the dugout have potential
Feels like Low hanging fruit
That’s my diet
Natalie, hot or not?
Nah. She’s skinny and blonde, but not hot.
Kinda got a great body though
She’s flat in my opinion
Yeah I know
Maybe I just like the whole tall thing
I should’ve had them on their streaming thing
I was unaware the media was being told
I had it like a half hour earlier but then called someone and just forgot about it
Yeah, Ben texted us
I even at-ed Tigers that was nice of me
I wasn’t sure if it was going to work out that way
It marks the 4th time in 2020 you have mentioned AtTigers
In 2019, you mentioned AtTigers three times. Look at you giving me some engagement on Twitter. That’s a good friend
Loved “In 2019, you mentioned AtTigers three times. Look at you giving me some engagement on Twitter. That’s a good friend”
You also mentioned us twice in 2017 and twice in 2018. So this is quite the step for you. One has to wonder if you’d do this whether I wasn’t there.
So let me get this straight
They still haven’t had you post anything about the streams?
Going to this evening as soon as I get a video from Niko. I wanted a player to help in the promotion of it.
They went to the media with it since they didn’t know when Niko would send something ...
If you’re chad or Ben, how hard is it to text him and ask for 30 seconds of his time. 5 to open the camera on his phone, 15 to record and 10 seconds to send.
For sure
Ben’s bitch ass got me
But I just smoked and I respect it
I identified the Tigers signed *six* undrafted free agents, basically owning up to me trolling them early on for not signing anyboyd
Wait, so you just got the number of them wrong?
Yeah
He e-mailed me right away
Have you tweeted anything about the stream yet?
Yeah, at 6:05
Nice
Dumb strategy by Ben
But hey thanks for the three hours of that star-fuck
Do you have to clear every tweet with him?
Because I’ll give you one that will do good
No, and I would resign if I did, no lie
Just checking
I’d put something out at 6:45 ... would’ve done it sooner but
“To reiterate: We will be streaming Tigers baseball tomorrow at noon. (GIF)”
Maybe work Dan Dickerson in there
Miggy big eyes gif maybe
“To reiterate: We will be streaming Tigers baseball tomorrow at noon and every camp day after that. (GIF)”
Dan Dickerson is too much I think
Could choose something other than “To reiterate”
At the beginning
Do you have any thoughts on this tweet
Remember when Twitter was 140
Is the tweet for your or for me?
For you

I would pass on that. Might do something like “The Tigers square off in a fierce battle against the Tigers.” Or How to be happy in three steps 1) Click this link 2) Turn the sound all the way up 3) Have someone yell “peanuts and cracker jacks” loudly.
I’m not talking about tomorrow
I’m talking about tonight. The Niko thing was 3 hours late and it wasn’t good enough, you gotta reset it
I could tweet something like, “Tweeting this again so you can like it again: The Tigers will be streaming their intra-squad games starting tomorrow (LINK)”
And it *probably?* will get 100 likes easy, factoring in Friday night
100 likes would be awful
I have 19,000 followers
You have 1.4 million
And Niko’s only got you 188
You’d get that in 15 min
5 min

I don’t fully understand what you’re talking about. And TBh, I still need to eat. So I’m going to go get food but I’ll probably leave my tweets alone tonight because I’m tired and lazy and promotional tweets like the one I sent don’t preform well in general.
Sorry I’m just ranting. Enjoy
